content.text: I found an important gap: the stored procedures (`SIM_Dorm_ADD/EDIT/GET/Search`) in the SQL baseline are still using the old column set (only `Price`), while the table and object `SIM_Dorm` already have the new columns. Without updating them, saving/loading will break. I'll create a patch file following the project's `3.SQL\patches\` convention.

input.contents:
/*
	Patch  : [dbo].[SIM_Dorm] - Thêm cột RoomPrice, BedCount, PersonCount và đồng bộ Price
	Date   : 2026-09-29
	Module : SIM
	Yêu cầu:
		Form frmDorm nhập thêm:
			- RoomPrice   : Đơn giá phòng
			- BedCount    : Số giường
			- PersonCount : Số người ở
			- Price       : Đơn giá từng người = RoomPrice / PersonCount
	Nguyên nhân:
		Bảng SIM_Dorm và đối tượng SIM_Dorm đã thêm cột mới nhưng các store
		SIM_Dorm_ADD / SIM_Dorm_EDIT / SIM_Dorm_GET / SIM_Dorm_Search chưa đồng bộ.
	Cách chạy:
		SSMS -> chọn database SIMS_NET -> F5 chạy toàn file.
*/

Use [SIMS_NET]
Go

Set Ansi_Nulls On
Go
Set Quoted_Identifier On
Go

Alter Procedure [dbo].[SIM_Dorm_ADD]
(
	@DormID nvarchar(50),
	@DormName nvarchar(500),
	@AreaID nvarchar(50),
	@RoomPrice decimal(18, 0) = null,
	@BedCount int = null,
	@PersonCount int = null,
	@Price decimal(18, 0) = null,
	@IsActived bit = 0,
	@Description nvarchar(4000) = null,
	@CreatedUser nvarchar(50)
)
As
Begin
	Set Nocount Off

	Insert Into [SIM_Dorm]
	(
		[DormID],
		[DormName],
		[AreaID],
		[RoomPrice],
		[BedCount],
		[PersonCount],
		[Price],
		[IsActived],
		[Description],
		[CreatedUser]
	)
	Values
	(
		@DormID,
		@DormName,
		@AreaID,
		@RoomPrice,
		Isnull(@BedCount, 0),
		Isnull(@PersonCount, 0),
		@Price,
		@IsActived,
		@Description,
		@CreatedUser
	)
End
Go

Set Ansi_Nulls On
Go
Set Quoted_Identifier On
Go

Alter Procedure [dbo].[SIM_Dorm_EDIT]
(
	@DormID nvarchar(50),
	@DormName nvarchar(500),
	@AreaID nvarchar(50),
	@RoomPrice decimal(18, 0) = null,
	@BedCount int = null,
	@PersonCount int = null,
	@Price decimal(18, 0) = null,
	@IsActived bit = 0,
	@Description nvarchar(4000) = null,
	@UpdatedUser nvarchar(50) = null
)
As
Begin
	Set Nocount Off

	Update [SIM_Dorm]
	Set
		[DormName] = @DormName,
		[AreaID] = @AreaID,
		[RoomPrice] = @RoomPrice,
		[BedCount] = Isnull(@BedCount, 0),
		[PersonCount] = Isnull(@PersonCount, 0),
		[Price] = @Price,
		[IsActived] = @IsActived,
		[Description] = @Description,
		[UpdatedUser] = @UpdatedUser,
		[UpdatedDate] = Getdate()
	Where [DormID] = @DormID
End
Go

Set Ansi_Nulls On
Go
Set Quoted_Identifier On
Go

Alter Procedure [dbo].[SIM_Dorm_GET]
(
	@DormID nvarchar(50)
)
As
Begin
	Set Nocount On

	Select
		[DormID],
		[DormName],
		[AreaID],
		[RoomPrice],
		[BedCount],
		[PersonCount],
		[Price],
		[IsActived],
		[Description],
		[CreatedUser],
		[CreatedDate],
		[UpdatedUser],
		[UpdatedDate]
	From [SIM_Dorm]
	Where [DormID] = @DormID
End
Go

Set Ansi_Nulls On
Go
Set Quoted_Identifier On
Go

Alter Procedure [dbo].[SIM_Dorm_Search]
As
Begin
	Set Nocount On

	Select
		SIM_DormBed.DormID,
		Count(*) As StudentCount,
		Sum(Case When SIM_Student.Gender = 1 Then 1 Else 0 End) As MaleNumber
	Into #tblStudentCount
	From SIM_RegisterDorm
		Inner Join SIM_Student On SIM_RegisterDorm.StudentID = SIM_Student.StudentID
		Inner Join SIM_DormBed On SIM_DormBed.DormBedID = SIM_RegisterDorm.DormBedID
		Inner Join SIM_Dorm On SIM_Dorm.DormID = SIM_DormBed.DormID
	Group By SIM_DormBed.DormID

	Select
		SIM_Dorm.DormID,
		SIM_Dorm.DormName,
		SIM_Dorm.AreaID,
		SIM_Dorm.RoomPrice,
		SIM_Dorm.BedCount,
		SIM_Dorm.PersonCount,
		SIM_Dorm.Price,
		SIM_Dorm.IsActived,
		SIM_Dorm.Description,
		#tblStudentCount.StudentCount,
		#tblStudentCount.MaleNumber,
		SIM_Dorm.CreatedUser,
		SIM_Dorm.CreatedDate,
		SIM_Dorm.UpdatedUser,
		SIM_Dorm.UpdatedDate
	From SIM_Dorm
		Left Join #tblStudentCount On #tblStudentCount.DormID = SIM_Dorm.DormID
End
Go
